name: jumia-vendor-mcp
description: MCP server for the Jumia Vendor Center GPM (catalog) and GOP (orders) APIs

client_id.title: Jumia Vendor Center Client Id
client_id.description: From your own Vendor Center account: Settings -> Applications -> a Self Authorization application. Leave unset to use `node src/setup.ts` / ~/.config/jumia-vendor-mcp/credentials.json instead.

refresh_token.title: Jumia Vendor Center Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Generated from the same Self Authorization application via 'Generate Token'. Stored in Claude Code's secure credential storage, not in this plugin's files.
